title: Users and assignments – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Users and assignments
hero.lead: This administration area connects Kaderblick user accounts to people, teams and clubs. Four tabs separate existing accounts, registration requests, supporter requests and, for super administrators only, demo requests.

body:
Users & assignments

Search filters by user. Each row shows the name, email address, account status and all existing assignments.

  • Verified identifies a confirmed email address; Active or Deactivated shows the account state. A further chip identifies locked accounts.
  • Assignment opens the account’s relations. These include player or coach relations and administrative, supporter, staff and official assignments to teams and clubs.
  • Role edits global user roles and is available only to super administrators.
  • Deactivate/Activate changes account access. Unlock appears for a locked account.
  • The envelope resends email verification. The bin deletes the entire user account after confirmation; both actions are available only to super administrators.

Understand person relations

  • Player self connects the account to its owner’s player profile.
  • Coach self connects it to its owner’s coach profile.
  • Other relation types can, for example, connect a parent account to a player profile.
  • A relation is not a user role: it states which person the account belongs to or how it relates to that person. Team and club assignments instead define the organisational scope.

Registration requests

During registration, new users can request a relation to a player or coach. The figure on the tab is the number of open requests.

Before selecting a person, the user chooses a team through a server-side search that displays team name, age group and club. The following person search is restricted to that team in the backend. In the administration list, continue to review the date, user, selected person, relation type and note.

  1. Filter by All, Pending, Approved or Rejected; the figures show the respective counts. Name search and pagination limit long lists.
  2. Review the date, user, named person, relation type and note.
  3. Approve a pending request with the tick. This creates the requested person relation.
  4. To reject it, open the cross and optionally enter a rejection reason.

Supporter requests

This tab handles requests for supporter access. The list shows the date, user, note, affected team and status. Approval and rejection work as for registration requests; a rejection reason can be entered. Opening a request from a notification highlights it and shows it regardless of the current status filter.

Demo requests

Only super administrators see demo requests. Filters distinguish all, pending, being created, active, failed, being removed and ended. The table shows the date, name and email, club or league, status and actions.

Who sees which actions?

  • Super administrator: sees all four tabs and role, account, verification and demo actions.
  • Club and team administration: manages assignments and requests within the permitted organisational scope; global account roles and demo administration remain reserved for super administrators.

Staff and official positions are maintained under Staff & officials and then also appear in this user overview.
